Ruling record · 2026-11-20T17:35Z · The maintainer answered the seat's decision card on 2026-11-20 at 17:35:23Z, and said it in words at 17:34:55Z.

Question, verbatim: 「主从子表默认改页签后，作者写了「表单里编辑」的明细表怎么办？」
Options: 「记录页退到页签，表单照旧」 (record page: a tab; the create/edit form keeps the embedded detail table because of `inlineEdit`) · 「一律只看分组」 (no field group naming it ⇒ the create/edit form no longer carries the detail table either; the three objects need group config to get it back) · 「带它的仍默认进概览」 (`inlineEdit` master-detail stays in the overview by default).
Answer, verbatim: 「一律只看分组」; in words: 「明细表应该改成指看分组的定义了。」

So for #35889: `inlineEdit` on a relationship no longer places a detail table by itself. A master-detail child goes into the record page's field area and the create/edit forms only when a field group names it (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`); otherwise it is a tab. The repo examples that relied on `inlineEdit` (the expense lines and invoice lines examples) and HotCRM's project budget lines get field-group entries naming their detail tables, so their forms keep the tables. The PR lists each such object.
